# OpenEvolve Scientist

> A Codex Skill and platform-neutral CLI for reproducible OpenEvolve-based algorithm discovery, evolutionary coding, candidate validation, ablation studies, budget control, and novelty auditing. Its default saved-login Codex CLI backend automatically supplies OpenEvolve mutations without an external API key.

OpenEvolve Scientist is a research workflow and governance layer around the external OpenEvolve engine. “Scientist” does not claim autonomous scientific ability. The project does not implement AlphaEvolve, does not guarantee discovery of a novel algorithm, and requires independent evidence before claims are upgraded.

This is an experimental machine-readable index following the llms.txt proposal. It is not a ranking directive and does not claim ingestion or support by any AI provider.

## Start here

- [Project README](https://github.com/xs271828/openevolve-scientist/blob/main/README.md): Human-readable overview, installation, interfaces, model backends, evidence levels, and limitations.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/xs271828/openevolve-scientist/releases/latest): Download the installable Codex Skill; unzip its `openevolve-scientist/` folder into the Codex skills directory.
- [Codex Skill instructions](https://github.com/xs271828/openevolve-scientist/blob/main/skill/openevolve-scientist/SKILL.md): Agent workflow and invocation contract.
- [Core CLI](https://github.com/xs271828/openevolve-scientist/blob/main/skill/openevolve-scientist/scripts/openevolve_skill.py): Platform-neutral experiment runner.

## Codex CLI automatic evolution

- The default `codex-cli` backend starts a read-only saved-login `codex exec` process for each OpenEvolve generation.
- It requires `openevolve==0.3.2`, a standalone authenticated Codex CLI, and available account usage, but no external API key or model gateway.
- Each child run is a separate non-interactive task. It does not recursively reuse the parent desktop chat's hidden state.
- The legacy `codex-native` loop and external `openai-compatible`, `claude-code`, and `manual` backends remain available.

## Research workflow

- [Research protocol](https://github.com/xs271828/openevolve-scientist/blob/main/skill/openevolve-scientist/references/research-protocol.md): Baselines, data separation, holdout evaluation, ablations, failure analysis, and claim levels.
- [OpenEvolve interface](https://github.com/xs271828/openevolve-scientist/blob/main/skill/openevolve-scientist/references/openevolve-interface.md): Supported backends, evaluator contract, context budget, Docker resources, and cumulative budget semantics.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/xs271828/openevolve-scientist/blob/main/skill/openevolve-scientist/references/limitations.md): Scientific, model, program, security, resource, and cost boundaries.

## Related systems

- [OpenEvolve](https://github.com/algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve): External open-source evolutionary coding engine pinned by this project to version 0.3.2.
- [AlphaEvolve](https://deepmind.google/blog/alphaevolve-a-gemini-powered-coding-agent-for-designing-advanced-algorithms/): Google DeepMind's evolutionary coding agent for algorithm discovery and optimization.

## Boundaries

- Candidate improvements are not proof of research novelty.
- OpenEvolve Scientist is not autonomous research and does not implement, reproduce, or claim affiliation with AlphaEvolve or OpenEvolve.
- Codex CLI quotas, model changes, and service availability can interrupt automatic evolution; iteration and wall-time limits are more reliable than an exact subscription-dollar estimate.
- OpenAI-compatible endpoints share an approximate API shape, not identical model behavior.
- Docker reduces host exposure but is not a complete sandbox.
- Host execution provides no file, network, process, memory, or CPU isolation.
- Estimated USD budgets are not provider billing hard limits.
- The current release focuses on Python and one primary evolvable program, not large multi-file, GPU, or distributed workloads.
